bead.title: Add local deployment release gate orchestration
bead.description:
PROBLEM: There is no single local deployment-release gate that composes the existing release gate, Helm static validation, chart packaging, docs/microsite checks, and kind backend smoke matrix while tolerating documented local Docker/kind unavailability.

ROOT CAUSE: `scripts/ci/release-gate.sh:103` starts the existing release gate at Rust coverage/product validation only, `scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh:231` packages and validates the chart separately, and `scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh:309` requires Docker/kind/kubectl/helm for real runs without a parent deployment gate that can document local cluster skips.

PROPOSED FIX: Create `scripts/ci/deployment-release-gate.sh` as the local orchestrator. It should run `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh`, `bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh`, chart packaging, and docs/microsite validation; then run `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend postgres_native` and `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection` only when Docker/kind/kubectl/helm are present and Docker is usable. If cluster tools are missing locally, print an explicit documented skip for only the kind portion and fail on any non-cluster check failure.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-4d588c37`; epic `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/04-build/BUILD-001-implementation-plan.md`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; `docs/deployment/helm-static-validation.md`; `docs/deployment/kind-helm-integration.md`.

DEPENDENCY IDS: `pqueue-728222f1`, `pqueue-0f1e8ba6`.

NON-SCOPE: Cutting the release tag.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestDeploymentReleaseGateRunsNonClusterChecks: `bash scripts/ci/deployment-release-gate.sh` runs `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh`, `bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh`, Helm chart packaging, and docs/microsite validation before any kind skip is allowed.
2. TestDeploymentReleaseGateLocalKindSkipsAreDocumented: on a host without usable Docker/kind, `bash scripts/ci/deployment-release-gate.sh` exits successfully only when the skipped portion is limited to the kind backend matrix and the output names the missing local capability.
3. TestDeploymentReleaseGateRunsBothBackendsWhenToolsExist: with Docker, kind, kubectl, and helm available, the gate runs `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend postgres_native` and `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection`.
4. TestReleaseGateCompositionPreserved: existing `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh` still passes independently and is invoked by the deployment gate without changing its existing behavior unless the change is explicitly documented in the script output.
5. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root after the gate script changes.
